stem:
Ethanal reacts with a mixture of $\text{HCN}$ and $\text{NaCN}$ to make 2-hydroxypropanenitrile, $\text{CH}_3\text{CH(OH)CN}$.

The reaction mechanism is nucleophilic addition.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain the meaning of the term *nucleophile* and identify the species which acts as the nucleophile during this reaction.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem: $\text{CH}_3\text{CH(OH)CN}$ exists as a pair of stereoisomers.
parts.text: Name the type of stereoisomerism shown by $\text{CH}_3\text{CH(OH)CN}$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
Draw three-dimensional diagrams of this pair of stereoisomers.

Indicate with an asterisk (*) the chiral centre on one of the structures drawn.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Give the structure of the organic product of the reaction of $\text{CH}_3\text{CH(OH)CN}$ with dilute sulfuric acid.
